query: MiniMax H3 generation with the int8-QK/per-channel-FP8-PV Sage kernel (_sageattn_int8_fp8_nhd) loses the GPU at the Windows driver level (nvlddmkm, requires reboot) on RTX 5060 Ti; a single-variable control shows native attention succeeds at higher VRAM/power, isolating the failure to the kernel.

desired.outcome: OP-confirmed workaround (comment by leimuxiao, 2 clean 260s runs): keep int8-QK, demote V from per-channel FP8 to plain FP16 and call the sm80 kernel _qattn_sm80.qk_int8_sv_f16_accum_f32_attn instead of the sm89 fp8-PV kernel — no GPU loss, still ~21% faster than native. FP8-PV on this path remains broken upstream.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
